title: GOOD QUALITY CHAIR FOR GENERAL OFFICE USE
text:
GOOD QUALITY CHAIR FOR GENERAL OFFICE USE. This is a good basic office chair. First the good:
- seems to be good quality
- easy to assemble
- back of the chair is comfortable and tilts back for extra comfort
- arms are adjustable slightly from side to side, so you can make the clearance a little wider if needed
- seat adjusts up and down to several heights with lever, just like most adjustable chairs
- attractive

Now the not so good:
- arms are not adjustable up and down, but seem to be a good height (arms could be removed if you didn't want them)
- arms are not padded, but reasonably comfortable; could get uncomfortable after a while
- seat angle seemed to push me forward somewhat, so I had to keep re-adjusting myself to stay at the back of the chair

I am using this chair at the dining room table for eating and playing cards for a couple of hours. The only problem is that the arms are at a height that they keep hitting the edge of the table. If I lower the chair so that the arms fit under the table, the seat is too low. I had one problem with this chair, but not especially the fault of the chair. I was sitting in it and assembling something in front of me that required some bending. I bent over a little far and the chair skidded out from under me and I fell and hurt myself. It should be noted that care needs to be taken when using a chair with casters, like this one, on tile. It moves very easy and can be a hazard if you aren't careful. Not the fault of this chair, as this will be true of any chair with wheels. Not a chair for klutzes, especially if using on a hard floor. As a final word, I would say this chair is comfortable for a couple of hours, but might not be so much for more time than that. Price of the chair seems reasonable for the quality, but you might find an equal quality chair on sale for less.

product_metadata.title: Niche Harrison Swivel Chair- Black
features: Breathable and adjustable mesh back provides lumbar support and accommodates most users
Curved armrests top the heavy-duty frame and complete the comfort of this chair
Functions: 360 degree swivel, seat height, back flex, tilt tension
Seat Height: 18-23-inches from floor, Seat Dimensions: 18.5-inches wide x 18-inches deep
description: The Harrison mesh-back task chair is both comfortable and good looking. The contoured mesh back provides excellent lumbar support and air circulation. Curved armrests and an amply padded seat add to the comfort of this chair. A comfortable black mesh covers the seat and matches any decor. The seat back reclines and is tension-adjustable to meet the needs of many users. Chair functions include swivel, height and back adjustments. Explanation of functions- 360 degree swivel: Chair is able to rotate 360 degrees in either direction. Seat height: Chair's seat can raise and lower allowing the user's feet to remain flat on the floor. Tilt tension: Allows user to adjust the amount of force that it takes to adjust the seat back angle. Back Flex: Chair back reclines as the seat remains in a fixed position. All Regency chairs are backed by a 5-year limited manufacturer's warranty on chair bases and frames and a 2-year limited manufacturer's warranty on chair mechanisms and upholstery.
